title: A river that follows a fault
text: The Kern Canyon Fault runs the length of the Kern River canyon, from the river's headwaters down to the Walker Basin. The fault was reactivated some 10 million years ago, and the Kern River modified its course to its present drainage path out of the foothills. The fault is geologically active. In the Sierra Nevada, the river sits in a classic V-shaped canyon as it erodes toward base level.

s2.title: Kern River
s2.quote: The geologically active Kern Canyon Fault runs the length of the canyon, from the river's headwaters down to the Walker Basin about 10 miles (16 km) south of Lake Isabella.
